# Checklist Template System - Complete Schema Documentation

## Overview

This document provides comprehensive schema definitions for the checklist template system, designed for n8n integration and app implementation. All data structures follow Firestore document schemas.

## Collection: `checklistTemplates`

**Purpose**: Global collection storing all OSHA-generated checklist templates (readable by all authenticated users, writable only by n8n/service account)

### Schema Definition

```typescript
interface ChecklistTemplate {
  // Document ID (auto-generated by Firestore)
  id: string;
  
  // Core Checklist Data
  title: string;                    // e.g., "Maintain Refrigerator Temperature Log"
  description: string;               // Detailed description of the task
  category: string;                 // e.g., "Food Safety", "Fire Safety", "Vehicle Safety"
  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
  
  // Filtering Metadata (used to match templates to users)
  applicableTo: {
    truckTypes: string[] | null;     // ["refrigerated", "food_truck"] or null (all types)
    foodTypes: string[] | null;      // ["perishable", "frozen"] or null (all types)
    businessTypes: string[] | null;   // ["food_truck", "catering"] or null (all types)
    locations: {
      states: string[] | null;       // ["CA", "NY"] or null (all states)
      cities: string[] | null;       // ["Los Angeles", "San Francisco"] or null (all cities)
    } | null;
    complianceAreas: string[] | null; // ["food_safety", "vehicle_safety"] or null (all areas)
  };
  
  // Scheduling Metadata
  frequency: 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'monthly' | 'quarterly' | 'yearly' | 'one_time';
  defaultDueTime: string;            // Time of day in "HH:mm" format (e.g., "09:00")
  startDate: string | null;          // ISO timestamp when template becomes active (null = always)
  endDate: string | null;            // ISO timestamp when template expires (null = never)
  
  // Regulation Reference
  source: 'osha_generated';           // Always "osha_generated" for templates
  regulationReference: {
    regulationNumber: string;        // e.g., "1910.1200" (OSHA), "FDA Food Code", etc.
    url: string;                     // Link to regulation (OSHA, FDA, state/local, DOT, EPA, etc.)
    section: string;                  // Specific section name
  } | null;
  
  // Metadata
  createdAt: Timestamp;               // Firestore serverTimestamp
  updatedAt: Timestamp;               // Firestore serverTimestamp
  version: number;                    // Template version (for tracking updates)
  isActive: boolean;                 // Whether template is currently active
}

// Note: The TypeScript schema above uses Firestore Timestamp objects for createdAt and updatedAt.
// The JSON examples in this document use ISO string timestamps (e.g., "2026-01-23T10:00:00Z") 
// only for readability. In actual Firestore documents, these fields are Timestamp objects.
```

### Example Document

```json
{
  "id": "template-001",
  "title": "Maintain Refrigerator Temperature Log",
  "description": "Record temperature readings every 4 hours. Must stay below 40°F for perishable foods.",
  "category": "Food Safety",
  "priority": "high",
  "applicableTo": {
    "truckTypes": ["refrigerated", "food_truck"],
    "foodTypes": ["perishable", "frozen"],
    "businessTypes": null,
    "locations": {
      "states": null,
      "cities": null
    },
    "complianceAreas": ["food_safety"]
  },
  "frequency": "daily",
  "defaultDueTime": "09:00",
  "startDate": null,
  "endDate": null,
  "source": "osha_generated",
  "regulationReference": {
    "regulationNumber": "FDA Food Code",
    "url": "https://www.fda.gov/food/fda-food-code",
    "section": "Food Code - Temperature Control"
  },
  // Note: The regulationReference field may point to various regulatory authorities:
  // OSHA (workplace safety), FDA (food safety), state/local regulations, DOT (transportation),
  // EPA (environmental), etc. The field name is generic to accommodate all compliance sources.
  "createdAt": "2026-01-23T10:00:00Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-01-23T10:00:00Z",
  "version": 1,
  "isActive": true
}
```

### Field Descriptions

#### Core Fields

- **title** (string, required): Human-readable title for the checklist item
- **description** (string, required): Detailed description explaining what needs to be done
- **category** (string, required): Category classification (e.g., "Food Safety", "Fire Safety", "Vehicle Safety")
- **priority** (string, required): Priority level - must be one of: "low", "medium", "high", "critical"

#### Filtering Fields (applicableTo)

- **truckTypes** (array of strings | null): Array of truck types this template applies to. Use `null` if applies to all truck types.
  - Valid values: "refrigerated", "food_truck", "flatbed", "tanker", "dry_van"
- **foodTypes** (array of strings | null): Array of food types this template applies to. Use `null` if applies to all food types.
  - Valid values: "perishable", "frozen", "prepared", "dry_goods", "beverages"
- **businessTypes** (array of strings | null): Array of business types this template applies to. Use `null` if applies to all business types.
  - Valid values: "food_truck", "catering", "restaurant", "mobile_kitchen"
- **locations.states** (array of strings | null): Array of US state codes (two-letter). Use `null` if applies to all states.
  - Valid values: "CA", "TX", "NY", etc. (see US_STATES constant)
- **locations.cities** (array of strings | null): Array of city names. Use `null` if applies to all cities.
- **complianceAreas** (array of strings | null): Array of compliance areas. Use `null` if applies to all areas.
  - Valid values: "food_safety", "fire_safety", "vehicle_safety", "environmental", "worker_safety"

**Filtering Logic**: 
- If a field is `null`, it means "applies to all"
- If a field is an array, the user must match at least one value in the array
- For truckType matching: The user's `businessProfile.truckType` (a single string value) must be present in the template's `applicableTo.truckTypes` array (i.e., `truckTypes.includes(user.truckType)`). If `truckTypes` is `null`, it applies to all truck types.
- All specified criteria must match for the template to apply to a user

#### Scheduling Fields

- **frequency** (string, required): How often this checklist item should be created
  - Valid values: "daily", "weekly", "monthly", "quarterly", "yearly", "one_time"
- **defaultDueTime** (string, required): Time of day when item is due, in "HH:mm" format (24-hour)
  - Example: "09:00" (9 AM), "14:30" (2:30 PM)
- **startDate** (ISO timestamp | null): When this template becomes active. Use `null` for always active.
- **endDate** (ISO timestamp | null): When this template expires. Use `null` for never expires.

#### Regulation Reference Fields

- **source** (string, required): Always "osha_generated" for templates created from regulations
- **regulationReference** (object | null): Reference to the compliance regulation/authority
  - **regulationNumber** (string): Regulation number or identifier (e.g., "1910.1200" for OSHA, "FDA Food Code", state/local codes, etc.)
  - **url** (string): Full URL to the regulation page (OSHA, FDA, state/local, DOT, EPA, etc.)
  - **section** (string): Specific section or subsection name

#### Metadata Fields

- **createdAt** (Timestamp): Firestore serverTimestamp - automatically set by Firestore
- **updatedAt** (Timestamp): Firestore serverTimestamp - automatically updated by Firestore
- **version** (number): Template version number (increment when template is updated)
- **isActive** (boolean): Whether template is currently active (false = hidden from users)

## Collection: `users` (UPDATE)

**New Field**: `businessProfile` object

### Schema Addition

```typescript
interface UserDocument {
  // Existing fields...
  userId: string;
  displayName: string;
  email: string;
  role: 'owner' | 'staff';
  preferences: {
    emailNotifications: boolean;
    pushNotifications: boolean;
    checklistReminders: boolean;
    reminderTime: string;
    checklistFrequency: string;
  };
  
  // NEW: Business Profile
  businessProfile: {
    truckType: string | null;         // "refrigerated" | "food_truck" | "flatbed" | "tanker" | null
    location: {
      state: string;                  // Two-letter state code (e.g., "CA", "TX", "NY")
      city: string | null;            // City name (optional)
    };
    foodTypes: string[];              // ["perishable", "frozen", "prepared", "dry_goods"]
    businessType: string | null;      // "food_truck" | "catering" | "restaurant" | null
    complianceAreas: string[];        // ["food_safety", "fire_safety", "vehicle_safety"]
    lastTemplateSync: string | null;   // ISO timestamp of last template sync
  } | null;                           // null if not set up yet
}
```

## n8n Integration Guide

### Data Structure for n8n Output

When n8n generates checklist templates from OSHA regulations, it should output data in this exact format:

```json
{
  "title": "Maintain Refrigerator Temperature Log",
  "description": "Record temperature readings every 4 hours. Must stay below 40°F for perishable foods.",
  "category": "Food Safety",
  "priority": "high",
  "applicableTo": {
    "truckTypes": ["refrigerated", "food_truck"],
    "foodTypes": ["perishable", "frozen"],
    "businessTypes": null,
    "locations": {
      "states": null,
      "cities": null
    },
    "complianceAreas": ["food_safety"]
  },
  "frequency": "daily",
  "defaultDueTime": "09:00",
  "startDate": null,
  "endDate": null,
  "source": "osha_generated",
  "regulationReference": {
    "regulationNumber": "1910.1200",
    "url": "https://www.osha.gov/laws-regs/regulations/standardnumber/1910/1910.1200",
    "section": "Hazard Communication"
  },
  "version": 1,
  "isActive": true
}
```

### Required Fields for n8n

**Required**:
- `title` (string) - Human-readable title
- `description` (string) - Detailed description
- `category` (string) - Category name
- `priority` (string) - Must be one of: "low", "medium", "high", "critical"
- `applicableTo` (object) - Filtering metadata object
- `frequency` (string) - Must be one of: "daily", "weekly", "monthly", "quarterly", "yearly", "one_time"
- `defaultDueTime` (string) - Time in "HH:mm" format (24-hour)
- `source` (string) - Must be "osha_generated"
- `version` (number) - Template version (start at 1)
- `isActive` (boolean) - Whether template is active

**Optional**:
- `regulationReference` (object | null) - Regulation/compliance reference (OSHA, FDA, state/local, DOT, EPA, etc.)
  - `regulationNumber` (string)
  - `url` (string)
  - `section` (string)
- `startDate` (ISO timestamp | null) - When template becomes active
- `endDate` (ISO timestamp | null) - When template expires

### n8n Workflow Steps

1. **HTTP Request Node** - Scrape OSHA website
   - URL: OSHA regulations page
   - Method: GET
   - Parse HTML response

2. **Code Node** - Parse HTML/content
   - Extract regulation text
   - Clean and structure data

3. **OpenAI/Claude Node** - Convert regulation to checklist template
   - **Prompt**: "Convert this OSHA regulation into a checklist template with the following structure: [schema]"
   - **Extract**:
     - Applicable criteria (truck type, food type, location)
     - Frequency (daily/weekly/monthly)
     - Priority level
     - Category
   - **Output**: JSON matching schema above

4. **Code Node** - Validate and structure data
   - Validate all required fields
   - Ensure enums match valid values
   - Format dates/times correctly
   - Set defaults for optional fields

5. **Firestore Node** - Write to `checklistTemplates` collection
   - Collection: `checklistTemplates`
   - Operation: Create document
   - Use service account credentials
   - Set `createdAt` and `updatedAt` to `serverTimestamp()`

### AI Prompt Template for n8n

```
Convert the following OSHA regulation into a checklist template:

Regulation: [REGULATION_TEXT]

Requirements:
1. Create a clear, actionable checklist item title
2. Write a detailed description explaining what needs to be done
3. Determine the appropriate category (Food Safety, Fire Safety, Vehicle Safety, etc.)
4. Assign priority (low, medium, high, critical)
5. Identify applicable criteria:
   - Truck types this applies to (refrigerated, food_truck, flatbed, tanker, dry_van) or null for all
   - Food types this applies to (perishable, frozen, prepared, dry_goods, beverages) or null for all
   - Business types (food_truck, catering, restaurant, mobile_kitchen) or null for all
   - States this applies to (two-letter codes like CA, TX, NY) or null for all
   - Cities this applies to or null for all
   - Compliance areas (food_safety, fire_safety, vehicle_safety, environmental, worker_safety)
6. Determine frequency (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly, one_time)
7. Suggest a default due time (HH:mm format, 24-hour)

Output as JSON matching this exact structure:
{
  "title": "...",
  "description": "...",
  "category": "...",
  "priority": "...",
  "applicableTo": {
    "truckTypes": [...] or null,
    "foodTypes": [...] or null,
    "businessTypes": [...] or null,
    "locations": {
      "states": [...] or null,
      "cities": [...] or null
    },
    "complianceAreas": [...] or null
  },
  "frequency": "...",
  "defaultDueTime": "...",
  "startDate": null,
  "endDate": null,
  "source": "osha_generated",
  "regulationReference": {
    "regulationNumber": "...",
    "url": "...",
    "section": "..."
  },
  "version": 1,
  "isActive": true
}
```

All constants are defined in `src/constants/checklistConstants.js`:

- `TRUCK_TYPES.FOOD_TRUCK` = "food_truck"
- `TRUCK_TYPES.FLATBED` = "flatbed"

### US States
Array of two-letter state codes: `["AL", "AK", "AZ", ...]`

## Filtering Logic

### How Templates Match Users

A template matches a user if ALL of the following conditions are met:

1. **Truck Type**: If template has `applicableTo.truckTypes`, user's `truckType` must be in the array
2. **Food Types**: If template has `applicableTo.foodTypes`, user must have at least one matching `foodType`
3. **Business Type**: If template has `applicableTo.businessTypes`, user's `businessType` must be in the array
4. **State**: If template has `applicableTo.locations.states`, user's `state` must be in the array
5. **City**: If template has `applicableTo.locations.cities`, user's `city` must be in the array (if user has city set)
6. **Compliance Areas**: If template has `applicableTo.complianceAreas`, user must have at least one matching `complianceArea`

**Important**: If any field in `applicableTo` is `null`, it means "applies to all" and that check is skipped.

## Scheduling Logic

### Frequency Behavior

- **daily**: Creates instance for today if not exists
- **weekly**: Creates instance for this week (Monday) if not exists
- **monthly**: Creates instance for this month (1st) if not exists
- **quarterly**: Creates instance for this quarter (1st of quarter) if not exists
- **yearly**: Creates instance for this year (Jan 1) if not exists
- **one_time**: Creates once, never again (checks if instance was ever created)

### Due Date Calculation

Due date is calculated as:
- Base date: Today (or specified date)
- Time: `defaultDueTime` from template (e.g., "09:00")
- Frequency adjustment: For weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly, date is adjusted to the start of that period

## Local Storage (AsyncStorage)

### Cache Keys

- `@checklist_templates_${userId}` - Cached templates
- `@checklist_instances_${userId}` - Cached active instances
- `@checklist_completed_${userId}` - Cached completed items (last 30 days)

### Cache Structure

```javascript
// Templates cache
{
  templates: ChecklistTemplate[],
  cachedAt: string, // ISO timestamp
  userProfileHash: string, // Hash of businessProfile
  version: number
}

// Instances cache
{
  items: ChecklistItem[],
  cachedAt: string,
  lastSync: string
}

// Completed cache
{
  items: ChecklistItem[],
  dateRange: { start: string, end: string },
  cachedAt: string
}
```

## Security Rules

### Firestore Rules

```javascript
// Helper function to check if user is authenticated
function isAuthenticated() {
  return request.auth != null;
}

// Checklist templates - readable by all authenticated users
match /checklistTemplates/{templateId} {
  allow read: if isAuthenticated();
  allow write: if false; // Prevent client writes (n8n uses service account)
}
```

### Storage Rules

No changes needed - templates are stored in Firestore, not Storage.

## Testing Checklist

- [ ] Templates can be read by authenticated users
- [ ] Templates cannot be written by clients
- [ ] Filtering logic matches templates to users correctly
- [ ] Scheduling logic creates instances at correct frequencies
- [ ] Cache is created and validated correctly
- [ ] Cache is invalidated on profile change
- [ ] Real-time listeners update active items
- [ ] Completed items are cached but not listened to
- [ ] Sync works on login
- [ ] Sync works on manual refresh
- [ ] Weekly background sync works

## Error Handling

All services handle errors gracefully:
- Network errors: Return cached data if available
- Validation errors: Log and skip invalid templates
- Firestore errors: Log and continue with available data
- Cache errors: Log warning but continue operation

## Performance Considerations

- Templates are cached locally (small dataset after filtering)
- Real-time listeners only for active items (reduces bandwidth)
- Completed items cached only (no real-time overhead)
- Weekly sync reduces unnecessary Firestore reads
- Profile hash detection prevents unnecessary syncs
